grammar_tips.title: There is/There are for Food
grammar_tips.explanation: Use 'There is/There are' to describe food items. Example: There are many dishes on the table.

explanation_translation.Hindi: खाद्य पदार्थों का वर्णन करने के लिए 'There is/There are' का उपयोग करें। उदाहरण: There are many dishes on the table.
explanation_translation.Japanese: 食べ物を説明するとき「There is/There are」を使います。例：There are many dishes on the table.

grammar_tips.title: Some/Any with Food
grammar_tips.explanation: Use 'some' for positive statements and 'any' for negatives/questions. Example: Do you have any rice?

explanation_translation.Hindi: सकारात्मक वाक्यों के लिए 'some' और नकारात्मक/प्रश्नवाचक वाक्यों के लिए 'any' का उपयोग करें। उदाहरण: Do you have any rice?
explanation_translation.Japanese: 肯定文には「some」、否定文や疑問文には「any」を使います。例：Do you have any rice?

grammar_tips.title: Would like for Ordering
grammar_tips.explanation: Use 'would like' to order food politely. Example: I would like a pizza, please.

explanation_translation.Hindi: खाना विनम्रता से ऑर्डर करने के लिए 'would like' का उपयोग करें। उदाहरण: I would like a pizza, please.
explanation_translation.Japanese: 食べ物を丁寧に注文するとき「would like」を使います。例：I would like a pizza, please.

grammar_tips.title: Adjectives for Taste
grammar_tips.explanation: Use adjectives like 'sweet, salty, sour, spicy' to describe food. Example: The soup is salty.

explanation_translation.Hindi: खाने का वर्णन करने के लिए 'sweet, salty, sour, spicy' जैसे विशेषणों का उपयोग करें। उदाहरण: The soup is salty.
explanation_translation.Japanese: 食べ物を説明するとき「sweet, salty, sour, spicy」などの形容詞を使います。例：The soup is salty.
